_source: SIMULATED - every field here is invented and none of it comes from the sandbox
_why: A situation names the cause, not the symptom, and says who to speak to. Producing these for real needs workflow work items and their error status, the approver substitution table, leave records, cost centre ownership and contract consumption. The sandbox exposes none of that. Never present this as live data.
_note: 'joined' lists the separate facts that had to be put side by side to spot the problem. That is the actual work: no single record says any of these things.

situations.title: Sunil is on leave and no stand-in was set
situations.detail: Five orders worth 1.1 crore stopped behind him. Nothing was technically wrong, the queue simply had nobody in it.
situations.who: Mr. Sunil Kulkarni is away until 12 Sep. Mr. Anil Deshmukh is his listed deputy.
situations.stuck: At the first approval step on five documents
situations.call: Confirm that Anil takes his approvals until the 12th
situations.followUp: Check on 12 Sep that Sunil is back and the stand-in is removed
joined: Workflow substitute table, no deputy active
Five work items at his step, 1.1 crore
situations.fix: Move his work to Anil Deshmukh, his listed deputy, until the 12th

situations.title: A Nagpur request never reached anyone
situations.detail: The request stopped before it started, because the system could not work out who owns cost centre 4100.
situations.who: Mr. Prakash Nair is waiting for it. Mr. Kiran Raghavan owns the cost centre.
situations.stuck: Between the request and the first approver
situations.call: Ask Kiran Raghavan to confirm he is the owner on record
situations.followUp: Ask master data to fix the cost centre owner so it does not repeat
situations.fix: Send it to Kiran Raghavan, the owner on the cost centre record

situations.title: Pune will run out of gypsum before the next load lands
situations.detail: Four days of stock, twelve days to bring more in, and three departments need 2,520 MT.
situations.who: Mr. Prakash Nair raised the demand. Oman Mining LLC supplied the last load.
situations.stuck: Nothing ordered yet, and the sea leg alone takes twelve days
situations.call: Approve the order the same day it reaches you
situations.speakTo: Mr. Anil Deshmukh, buyer for raw materials
situations.followUp: Check on 15 Sep that the vessel is confirmed
situations.fix: Prepare the order now and mark it for same day approval

situations.title: A contract worth 2.4 crore has never been used
situations.detail: The Bharat Bearings spares contract expires in 26 days with nothing bought against it.
situations.who: Bharat Bearings holds the contract. Mr. Sanjay Bose raises the spares demand.
situations.stuck: 26 days left, no release order placed
situations.call: Decide whether to use it or let it lapse
situations.followUp: Look at it again on 20 Sep, before the last week
situations.fix: Ask the buyer whether to use it or let it lapse

situations.title: Aditya Refractories keeps getting later
situations.detail: They have gone from on time to eleven days late over their last ten orders, and are charging 6.3 percent above contract.
situations.who: Vendor V-10024. Mr. Anil Deshmukh cleared their last order at step 1.
situations.stuck: PO 4500178401 for 1.16 crore is waiting with you now
situations.call: Look at the delivery record before you release the order
situations.followUp: Ask the vendor for a written recovery plan by 20 Sep
joined: Last ten deliveries, on time to 11 days late
situations.fix: Put the record in front of the approver before the 1.16 crore order is released

situations.title: Nagpur is about to buy grinding media off contract
situations.detail: Each part of this looks normal on its own. Together, you are 26 days from losing an agreed rate and about to pay spot price for the same material.
situations.who: Mr. Rahul Kamat holds the contract. Mr. Sanjay Bose raised the requisition.
situations.stuck: The requisition is being sourced as a fresh enquiry, not as a release against the contract
situations.call: Have the requisition converted into a release order on 4600001155
situations.followUp: Check on 20 Sep that the release order is placed and the contract is being used
joined: Stock at Nagpur, 22 MT against a 60 MT reorder level
situations.fix: Convert PR 1000442190 into a release order against contract 4600001155

situations.title: A conveyor belt contract is sitting unused while the same belt is bought at spot price
situations.detail: An 1.8 crore agreement with Konkan Conveyors has never been drawn on. The order in front of you for the same belt is at 1985 a metre against 1850 agreed, which is 1.35 lakh more than it needs to be.
situations.who: Mr. Rahul Kamat raised the order. Mr. Anil Deshmukh signed the contract in March.
situations.stuck: Nothing is stuck. The contract is simply not being quoted on the order.
situations.call: Ask the buyer to put the order against the contract before it is released
situations.followUp: Check next week that the contract number is on the order
situations.fix: Put order 4500178512 against contract 4600001211 at the agreed rate

situations.title: Cooler castable runs out eight days before a new load could arrive
situations.detail: Twenty-six tonnes on hand, ninety-five asked for by the kiln and the cooler overhaul, and nothing on order. At today's use the stock lasts eight days and the lead time is eighteen.
situations.who: Asked for by R. Iyer for Kiln 1 and S. Bose for the cooler overhaul.
situations.stuck: Requisition 1000442288 has been open twelve days with no order against it
situations.call: Get the requisition converted today, and ask Aditya for a part load against the shortfall
situations.followUp: Confirm on 12 Sep that an order exists and has a date
joined: Stock 26 MT against 95 MT of departmental demand
Nothing on order, lead time 18 days
situations.fix: Raise the order for 69 MT against the open requisition

situations.title: Two orders on Bharat Bearings are part received with no date for the balance
situations.detail: Order 4500177455 is seventy percent received and fourteen pieces short. The vendor has said next week twice. Nobody has put a confirmed date back on the order, so the mill has nothing to plan against.
situations.who: Mr. Prakash Nair handles goods receipt at Nagpur. Mr. Rahul Kamat owns the vendor.
situations.stuck: The balance quantity has no confirmed delivery date against it
situations.call: Get a firm date in writing and put it on the order
situations.followUp: Chase again on 15 Sep if the date has not appeared
joined: Vendor standing 53 out of 100, getting worse
No confirmed date on the balance line
situations.fix: Mail the vendor for a confirmed date on the fourteen pieces outstanding

situations.title: The imported coal contract is 94 percent used with four months still to run
situations.detail: One crore twenty lakh is left on a twenty-one crore agreement that runs to January. The order in front of you is nine crore, so the contract is exhausted the moment it is released and everything after that is bought at spot price.
situations.who: Mr. Sanjay Bose negotiated the agreement with Jebel Coal DMCC.
situations.stuck: Nothing is stuck. The value is simply about to run out ahead of the date.
situations.call: Start the extension now rather than after the contract is empty
situations.followUp: Check on 20 Sep that an extension has been raised
situations.fix: Raise an extension on contract 4600001178 before the next order goes out
